name: cajeerengine
product_changes: End-to-End Regression 1.8.6: eliminate lost file-backed CMS preview tokens with an inter-process lock and TTL pruning; expire tokens before usage writes; exercise full CMS draft/preview/publication/search/static export lifecycle and 16 concurrent preview writers, and make real HTTP middleware, migrated SQLite, queue, media, import/export and AI acceptance a mandatory CI gate.

Performance & Load Testing 1.8.5: remove public search publication-row shared locks by using repeatable-read MVCC snapshots; serialize concurrent public render cache misses per path without hiding render errors; reduce PostgreSQL queue lease-recovery round trips during active work while preserving forced idle recovery; ship concurrent PHP and HTTPS staging load acceptance with measurable RPS/latency/error gates.

Database & Compatibility 1.8.4: execute immutable MySQL migrations on both MySQL 8.4 and MariaDB 10.11 by translating unsupported ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS into column-existence checks; split SQL scripts for portable PDO execution; reject mismatched migration dialects; detect missing and modified applied migrations; verify full PostgreSQL/MySQL/SQLite migrations in isolated CI databases.

Runtime & Queue Resilience 1.8.4: isolate scheduler tasks after queue/backend failures, preserve completed effects on uncertain acknowledgement, surface transport outages as HTTP 503 and CLI failures, redact scheduler errors, and execute fault-injection regressions.

Security Hardening 1.8.2: owner-constrained API token revocation; strict token issuance validation; HTTPS-only webhook destinations with signing secret rotation on receiver change; no webhook signing secrets in list/update or receiver responses in logs; production error redaction and database diagnostic privacy; executable security regressions.

Identity SkiF4er ID GA 1.6.0: atomic SSO unlink and session revocation, callback registry validation, serializable subject-mapping login, bounded signed token assertions, resilient real admin session UX and integration acceptance.
AI Assistant ChatGPT 1.6.1: encrypted OpenAI configuration, live Responses API SSE streaming, durable per-user conversations, monthly budget reservation and recovery, Nuxt and static SPA UI.
AI Content Editor 1.6.2: live generation and rewriting of title/text/richtext/block fields, durable per-user proposals, token budget reservations, revision CAS acceptance, and both admin interfaces.

AI CMS Diagnostics 1.6.5: real OperationsMonitor/SecurityHardener probes, redacted runtime event aggregation, actionable read-only rules, optional budgeted OpenAI explanation, Nuxt and production static SPA.

AI Knowledge Base 1.6.6: authenticated category/document workflows, TXT/Markdown/PDF import, published CMS entry sync, separate private full-text inverted index, optimistic revisions and dual admin interfaces.

AI Knowledge Chat / RAG 1.6.7: owner-scoped indexed retrieval, published/current CMS source guards, referenced OpenAI answers, feedback, audit and protected conversation histories in both admin interfaces.

AI Support Center 1.6.8: public guest widget with per-ticket capability tokens, operator ticket queue, assignments, replies, handoff, and public-only RAG suggestions, live DB acceptance and dual admin UI.

AI Security & Acceptance 1.6.9: outbound credential rejection before OpenAI HTTP, durable token budget and existing permissions, race-safe idempotent support replies, opt-in bounded privacy retention with rollback, real PDO acceptance and offline secret-boundary regression.
AI Assistant ChatGPT GA 1.7.2: read-only live deployment acceptance, optional OpenAI provider probe, concurrent ticket and RAG protection, and complete CI AI regression gates.

AI External Analytics 1.7.3: evidence-based per-provider comparisons and seven-day changes on persisted reports, credential-free AI explanations with shared monthly budget, read-only CMS tool, dual admin interfaces and release regressions.

AI SEO & Content Insights 1.7.4: exact CMS URL matching against saved page-level analytics, conservative period comparisons, prioritized SEO audits and revision-confirmed proposals in Nuxt and static SPA.

AI Migration Copilot 1.7.5: read-only post-import DLE/WordPress audit from saved reconciliation and bounded live target redirects/media/route checks, prioritized operator guidance, credential-free AI explanation, Nuxt and SPA.

AI Migration Remediation 1.7.6: operator-approved one-time 301 redirect restoration from verified saved migration evidence and public route index repair, revalidation, transactional rollback, strict project/user ownership, Nuxt and static SPA.

AI Automation Security & Acceptance 1.7.9: serialized per-owner quota locks, queue dead-letter reconciliation, fair retry offers, stale-run timeout, redacted worker exceptions, 30-day prompt cleanup, live acceptance tests.

AI Automation GA 1.8.0: standalone (still disabled) RabbitMQ deterministic IDs/one-attempt policy, fail-safe queue scans, operator kill switch, immediate soft-delete prompt redaction, bounded retention and backlog metrics, regression checks.

Release Baseline & CI Stabilization 1.8.1: synchronized runtime/admin/SDK versions, restored missing AI Automation OpenAPI endpoints and SDK operations, real PHP syntax gates, complete PHPUnit/analysis gates, and verified release artifacts.
